findings_from_the_gallery: Wrong compound structures in the PathWhiz screenshots were a harness artefact, not our PWML: new compounds get sequential pwc_ids (PW_C0000nn) in the empty database and the viewer loads moldb.wishartlab.com/molecules/<pwc_id>/image.png, which belongs to unrelated production compounds (5-HT drawn as a diamine, sphingomyelin as a steroid). Our PWML carries the correct ids and writes no structure. Fix in the harness copy: block the request and remove the elements.

PathWhiz draws one box per biological state: two ER boxes in idx 116, two plastid boxes in idx 7 (our SVG merges them).
